description: Eaux pluviales - Avaloirs - Angers Loire Métropole is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Angers Loire Métropole. Localisation et description des avaloirs. Base de données en construction. Numéro (NUMERO): identifiant unique de l’objet Type (TYPE): classer selon différents critères (Grille (GRILLE) / bouche d’égout avec plaque de recouvrement (BEPLAQURECOUVR) / bouche d’égout grille(BEGRILLE) / bouche d’égout grille avec plaque de recouvrement (BEGRILLEPLAQRECOUVR) / bouche d’égout (BE)). Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Réseaux, Energies. Its keywords are eau, eaux pluviales. The portal shows 20,987 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
